comparison.objective: Stow a clamp lever on an articulated light arm without moving the light; candidate adjusts and locks a damper collar.
comparison.physical_skill: Lever repositioning while stabilizing an articulated arm versus recessed-key loosening, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and bounded retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Lever stowed while lamp pose remains undisturbed versus safe dynamic stop behavior and retained damper setting.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared stabilization-and-lock-control primitive, but the candidate additionally tests iterative energy-absorption tuning through physical cycles, a meaningfully different ability.
